description: Rebuild a PDF from a page list: reorder, delete (leave pages out), duplicate (list a page twice) and insert blank pages. "3, 1-2, blank, 5-" puts page 3 first, then 1-2, a blank page (same size as the page before it), then 5 to the end; page 4 is dropped. Optionally rotate pages of the result. Existing page rotation is kept. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-organizer/

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

pages.description: New page order (1-based source pages): e.g. "3, 1-2, blank, 2, 5-". Pages not listed are removed; "blank" adds an empty page.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

rotate.description: Optional rotations applied to pages of the new order.

pages.description: Pages of the NEW order, e.g. "1, 3-4".

name: pdf_organize
title: Organize PDF pages
